label: Whatever team you land on
title: Here's what comes with it.
intro: Every team in Tartaros operates with the same culture — serious about the game, reasonable about everything else.

perks.title: Inactivity is handled fairly
perks.body: Going away or need time off? Just let us know in advance. Life comes first and your spot will be there when you're back.

perks.title: Coordination before every event
perks.body: Strategy is planned and communicated clearly before events begin. You'll always know what the goal is and what's expected of you.

perks.title: A player base that helps
perks.body: Whether it's strategies, troubleshooting, or just someone to play alongside — people here are willing to help. Ask questions and you'll get answers.

perks.title: No toxic behaviour, no elitism
perks.body: We compete seriously but keep things respectful. Everyone is at a different stage and that's treated as normal, not something to criticise.

perks.title: No obsessive grinding
perks.body: Use your tickets and play your part. We don't expect you to be online constantly — consistent, decent participation is what matters.

perks.title: Boss Rush access
perks.body: We run Boss Rush on our lower teams. Not interested in playing? You can still collect rewards once the team clears all islands.

perks.title: Events beyond BTD6
perks.body: We run server-wide events including Minecraft, skribbl.io, and others — for when you want to spend time with the community outside of the game.

perks.title: Room to move up
perks.body: Start wherever suits your current level and progress at your own pace. The pathway to higher teams is open to anyone who puts in the effort.
